baseline_arm.identity: frozen production qualification pipeline, paper-pilot-v2.1.3 / handler 2.1.9
baseline_arm.treatment_source: the production dispositions recorded on each candidate (state + reasonCode) — never recomputed, never altered

evaluation_standard.costs: frozen 18 bps roundtrip clause, identical for both arms (evaluator crypto-evaluation-v5-corrected: first-touch TOUCH, +/-1.5R / +/-2.5R, 30-day cap)
evaluation_standard.dependence: candidates sharing an asset or a discovery run are one cluster; reports state raw counts and cluster counts; intervals cluster-adjusted
evaluation_standard.insufficient_evidence: INCONCLUSIVE — never promotes, never extends the window silently
evaluation_standard.promotion: separate explicit decision by Logan after a review; nothing in this registration promotes anything
evaluation_standard.retuning: forbidden; any rule-text change voids this registration and requires a new one
evaluation_standard.review_checkpoints: 30 matured divergences AND 8 weeks from registration — reporting points with uncertainty, not adoption triggers

immutability: This registration and its rule text are immutable once frozen. The scorer verifies the rule text hash on every run and refuses to score on mismatch.
registered_by: Coordinator Z10, on Logan's approval of Challenger-R1 shadow implementation (2026-10-21), incorporating Logan's six registration corrections
scope_limits_stated_at_registration: R4 (ATH contextual): the pilot candidate record carried into the vessel contains no ATH/SMA/trend fields, so the component records unverified per candidate and contributes no divergences until the discovery record is joined; the rule is registered in full and activates as written when the fields arrive.

Challenger would-issues are recorded in the shadow ledger with their would-be contracts; automated settlement enrollment of shadow positions under the venue monitor is not part of this wiring step and is flagged in the scorer output (settlement_status: not_enrolled_shadow_bookkeeping_only).

scorer.input: the live paper status pull saved by the collection cron (getpaperpilotstatus response JSON)
scorer.prospective_guard: candidates with decisionAt before frozen_at_utc are refused (counted, never written); no backfilling
